ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee; advise rider that cancellations after the 3-minute matching window are chargeable per NS-4 and that a fee-waiver request may be submitted via RydeHELP within 30 days (NS-7).

rejected_claims.reason: The driver was indeed ~1.5 km from the pickup when the rider cancelled (GPS 1.34409,103.73033 vs pickup 1.333,103.7422) and chat shows the driver estimating 'About 5 min, traffic', but Ryde publishes no late-ETA free-cancellation rule (NS-8 informational), so this fact does not itself decide the case; the refund follows from NS-4/NS-2 instead.
